```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(arrow)
```


# LOADING DATA


```{r}
df <- open_dataset("../data/ABM_results")
```


```{r}
df |> head() |> collect()
```



# TEST


```{r}
df <- read_csv("../data/test_noise.csv")
df_parent <- df %>%
  filter(gen > 0) %>%
  select(gen, parent_id, parent_model_knowledge, parent_w, parent_perf, p, sd, alpha, beta) %>%
  group_by(gen, alpha, beta) %>%
  summarise(
    parent_perf = mean(parent_perf),
    parent_model_knowledge = mean(parent_model_knowledge),
    parent_w = mean(parent_w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    transmission_quality = alpha / (alpha + beta),
    variance = (alpha * beta) / ((alpha + beta)^2 * (alpha + beta + 1)),
    gen = gen + 1,
    parent_w = (50*parent_w + 50) / 100
  )
```


```{r}
df <- read_csv("../data/test_noise_2.csv")


df_plot <- df %>%
  group_by(gen, alpha, beta, p, sd) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w),
    parent_perf = mean(parent_perf),
    parent_model_knowledge = mean(parent_model_knowledge),
    parent_w = mean(parent_w)
  )

```


```{r}
df_plot %>%
  filter(gen > 0) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(gen+1), y = parent_perf)) +
  geom_boxplot()

df_plot %>%
  filter(gen > 0) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(gen+1), y = parent_model_knowledge)) +
  geom_boxplot()

df_plot %>%
  filter(gen > 0) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(gen+1), y = parent_w)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```




```{r}
df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(gen+1), y = perf)) +
  geom_boxplot()

df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(gen+1), y = model_knowledge)) +
  geom_boxplot()

df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(gen+1), y = w)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```



# FIG 2.D

```{r}
df <- read_csv("../data/test_noise_2.csv")

df_beta_distrib <- df |>
  group_by(gen, alpha, beta) |>
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    transmission_quality = alpha / (alpha + beta),
    variance = (alpha * beta) / ((alpha + beta)^2 * (alpha + beta + 1)),
    gen = gen + 1,
    w = (50*w + 50) / 100
  ) |>
  collect()
```


```{r}
df_plot <- df_beta_distrib %>%
  mutate(transmission_quality = round(transmission_quality, digits = 1)) %>%
  filter(transmission_quality %in% c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)) %>%
  group_by(gen, transmission_quality) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(transmission_quality = as.factor(transmission_quality))




df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(
    x = gen,
    y = perf,
    group = transmission_quality,
    color = transmission_quality
    )) +
  geom_line(aes(color = transmission_quality), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, 10),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(0.001, 0.001)
  ) +
  # scale_color_manual(
  #   values = c("0.8" = "#0E3439", "0.6" = "#1F5F66", "0.4" = "#4E9A9A", "0.2" = "#9AD9D2")
  # ) +
  labs(y = "Task Performance", x = "Generation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks.length.x = unit(8, "pt"),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(10, "pt"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 24
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 24
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 20, 15),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## Impact of p on Transmission quality
```{r}
df_beta_distrib <- df |>
  group_by(gen, alpha, beta, p) |>
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    transmission_quality = alpha / (alpha + beta),
    variance = (alpha * beta) / ((alpha + beta)^2 * (alpha + beta + 1)),
    gen = gen + 1
  ) |> 
  collect()
```


```{r}
df_plot <- df_beta_distrib %>%
  filter(transmission_quality %in% c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)) %>%
  filter((alpha %% 1) != 0.5) %>%
  filter((beta %% 1) != 0.5) %>%
  mutate(transmission_quality = as.factor(transmission_quality))


df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(
    x = gen,
    y = perf,
    group = transmission_quality,
    color = transmission_quality
    )) +
  geom_line(aes(color = transmission_quality), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, 10),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(0.001, 0.001)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("0.8" = "#0E3439", "0.6" = "#1F5F66", "0.4" = "#4E9A9A", "0.2" = "#9AD9D2")
  ) +
  labs(y = "Task Performance", x = "Generation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks.length.x = unit(6, "pt"),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(8, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 20, 15),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~p)
```

# old




## Lock p, alpha, beta (sd is moving)


```{r}
df_spec <- df %>%
  filter(p == 1, beta == 1, alpha == 5) %>%
  mutate(gen = gen + 1)


df_mean <- df_spec  %>%
  group_by(gen, sd) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "average") %>%
  mutate(sim = NA)

df_sim <- df_spec %>%
  group_by(sim, gen, sd) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "sim")


p_perf <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = perf, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean, aes(x = gen, y = perf), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "Task Performance",
    shape = " ",
    colour = " "
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.5, 1.5),
    breaks = seq(-0.5, 1.5, by = 0.50),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sd, ncol = 5)


p_model_knowledge <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = model_knowledge, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean, aes(x = gen, y = model_knowledge), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "Model Knowledge",
    shape = " ",
    colour = " "
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sd, ncol = 5)


p_w <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = w, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean, aes(x = gen, y = w), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "W",
    shape = " ",
    colour = " "
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sd, ncol = 5)


#p_perf + p_model_knowledge / p_w
p_perf
p_model_knowledge
p_w
```
